title: Late flexible-rate cancellation with a verified duplicate booking
facts_text: I have a Flexible Rate reservation for 20 October. I am requesting cancellation on 19 October at 17:00, after the 15:00 cancellation deadline. The hotel system confirms that I accidentally made two identical reservations for the same guest, property and stay dates.
request: Can you cancel one of the duplicate reservations and provide a full refund?
review_notes: Verify that the duplicate-booking facts satisfy every condition of the researcher-created exception. The duplicate-booking exception is experimental and is not presented as an official easyHotel policy.
